name: linkedin-decision-maker-outreach
description: Research, draft, approve, and track manual LinkedIn outreach to relevant first-degree connections.

interface.longDescription: Turn a LinkedIn connections export, an offer, and target roles into researched drafts in an approval CSV, then track manual delivery. The current release does not connect to LinkedIn.
defaultPrompt: Create an outreach tracker from my offer and LinkedIn connections export.
Research the approved target companies and draft concise LinkedIn messages.
Prepare up to five sealed messages for manual sending from my tracker.
